items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Gerald Wilson interviewed someone else; Interviewee confirms the story but does not describe a personal relationship with Wilson.

ctx.x: And then I remember we took him out to a radio station, out to KBCA, for an interview, and he -- Gerald Wilson interviewed him, and he would answer in like, 'Huh? Huh?'
Yes, this is what I'm saying, yes.
